youtube.aciklama: In babies, the first threshold estimate is made with frequency-specific tone burst ABR, and hearing aid settings start from these estimated thresholds. In the example case, when the baby was developmentally ready, visual reinforcement audiometry (VRA) was done at seven months, and with insert earphones ear-specific thresholds were 50 to 65 dB HL on the right and 45 to 60 dB HL on the left. These values agreed with the ABR estimates; this agreement increases confidence in the hearing aid settings.
